Erin (Support): Escalation T-20034: trial tenant SpectraLabs hitting embed failures after SSO attribute mapping. Their validation run is mid-flight; renewal review in 4 days.
Marco (CS): Need a 2-line customer note + impact summary and contact. Also flag whether to offer a credit; AE on the thread for exec context.
Erin (Support): Impact: embed success dropped from ~99% to ~30% in the last 45m. Logs show repeated 'POST /v1/embeds -> 504 gateway timeout -> kvcache eviction'. Tried: pool restart, token rotate, bumped timeouts, no change. Contact: Brendan Lee (brendan@spectralabs.com), PST.
Lin (Solutions): Short-term mitigation: route SpectraLabs to a dedicated 3-hour slice and pin to rwd-embed-stable-3b to reduce working set churn. Also suggest tenant prefix caching TTL=3600. Patch I can stage once Ops provisions.
Pri (Ops): I can provision a 3-hour burst (2xA10G) if AE approves reserved credits. Will run smoke tests and post validation curl. Incident bridge created -> https://zoom.redwood/bridge/BRG-20034 (auto).
Claire (AE): Approving use of reserved burst for now given proximity to renewal; AE will join the post-mitigation sync. Recommend offering a one-time trial credit if disruption impacts their validation metrics.
Marco (CS): Erin please draft the customer message (2 lines + ETA). Include whether we should offer a credit. I will send once Ops confirms pool is up.
Erin (Support): Draft to send: "Hi Brendan - we	re seeing intermittent timeouts from our embeddings API after your recent SSO mapping change. We're applying a temporary mitigation (route to a dedicated slice) within the next 60 minutes and will update you by 13:30 PST. Apologies for the disruption; we'll follow with an RCA and can offer a one-time credit for impacted validation runs."
Marco (CS): Tweak: cc cs@redwood.com and offer a 10% trial credit. Scheduling 13:30 PST bridge for validation and customer demo check.
Pri (Ops): Provisioning slice-spectralab-1 now, ETA ~9m. Smoke validation command (support console):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"smoke"}' | jq '.status, .latency_ms'
```
Expect: status "ok", latency <200ms.
incident-bot: provision complete for slice-spectralab-1 (2xA10G).
Erin (Support): Verified smoke: 20/20 success, median latency 170ms. Sending Marco the draft. Captured request IDs for RCA.
Marco (CS): Outreach sent to Brendan (cc cs@redwood.com, cc Claire). Internal comms checklist: 1) notify AE + renewal owner, 2) ops mitigation window 3h, 3) offer 10% trial credit, 4) run post-mitigation validation with customer on bridge, 5) open RCA and assign Eng owner within 48h. Marking Priority: High.
Lin (Solutions): Adding follow-up action: evaluate auto-model-pin for trials and a telemetry alert for embed error rate >15% sustained for 30m. I'll file a ticket.
Claire (AE): I'll join bridge and capture customer tone for renewal playbook. If customer requests executive touch, escalate to me.
Marco (CS): After the sync paste any verbatim customer feedback here so CS can update renewal risk. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
